hypotheses.lean: lam : Measure S, 𝓕 : Set (GenerativeFlow S)
hypotheses.rewrite: state space (S, lambda), a family of generative flows

hypotheses.lean: μ ν probability measures, μ ≪ lam, ν ≪ lam
hypotheses.rewrite: two probability distributions mu, nu ≪ lambda

hypotheses.lean: ∃ C, rnDeriv ≤ C lam-a.e. (for each of μ, ν)
hypotheses.rewrite: bounded density: dmu/dlambda ≤ C and dnu/dlambda ≤ C lambda-a.e.

hypotheses.lean: ∀ ε > 0 (in ℝ≥0∞), ∃ F ∈ 𝓕, initialError F.policy F.outflow ν μ univ + terminalError ... univ < ε
hypotheses.rewrite: every ε>0 a flow in the family with δF_init(S)+δF_term(S) < ε for F_init = nu, F_term = mu (def:virtual_flows' errors: (F_init+F_in−F_term−F_out)^∓)
